name: akta.pro
summary: Company data, headcount, traffic, jobs, reviews, news signals and generated company lists from akta.pro.

api_key.description: an akta.pro API key (from the akta.pro playground, https://playground.akta.pro)

notes: Priced in credits: USD 0.05 per credit pay-as-you-go, 0.04 on a subscription. Every response reports credits_consumed.
Alternative-data endpoints (headcount, traffic, jobs, posts, reviews) need a Subscription or Enterprise plan.
Call company.search first to get a UUID, or pass a website directly as company.

endpoints.name: Resolve a company by name or website
endpoints.summary: Returns the UUID other endpoints use. Free: consumes no credits.

query.description: Company name or website; the input type is detected automatically.

endpoints.name: Get company data sections
endpoints.summary: Firmographics, business model, financial estimates, location, technology and more for one company.

company.description: Company website (e.g. canva.com) or an akta.pro company UUID from company.search.

sections.description: Comma-separated sections to return; all available if omitted. Values: firmographic, business_model, company_assessment, trust_signal, company_hierarchy, digital_presence, financial_estimate, location, management_profile, product_offering, strategic_signal, customer_profile, industry, technology. (funding_detail and mna_and_investment need a subscription or enterprise plan.)

notes: Credits are charged per section requested (0.5 to 5 each), so ask only for the sections you need.

endpoints.name: Get headcount trends
endpoints.summary: LinkedIn-sourced employee count, history, growth rates and function breakdown.

company.description: Company website (e.g. canva.com) or an akta.pro company UUID from company.search.

notes: Subscription and Enterprise plans only; pay-as-you-go answers 403.

endpoints.name: Get website traffic signals
endpoints.summary: Engagement metrics, monthly visit estimates and traffic by acquisition source.

company.description: Company website (e.g. canva.com) or an akta.pro company UUID from company.search.

notes: Subscription and Enterprise plans only; pay-as-you-go answers 403.

endpoints.name: List a company's job posts
endpoints.summary: Live LinkedIn and Indeed listings with location, salary and key skills.

company.description: Company website (e.g. canva.com) or an akta.pro company UUID from company.search.

limit.description: Maximum number of job listings to return (default 10).

notes: Subscription and Enterprise plans only; pay-as-you-go answers 403.

endpoints.name: List a company's social posts

company.description: Company website (e.g. canva.com) or an akta.pro company UUID from company.search.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return (default 10).

notes: Subscription and Enterprise plans only; pay-as-you-go answers 403.

endpoints.name: Get employee reviews
endpoints.summary: Overall and dimension-level ratings plus individual reviews.

company.description: Company website (e.g. canva.com) or an akta.pro company UUID from company.search.

notes: Subscription and Enterprise plans only; pay-as-you-go answers 403.

endpoints.name: Find industry codes
endpoints.summary: Matching industry codes ranked by similarity. Free.

level.description: Taxonomy level or comma-separated levels: l1, l2, l3, l4, all (default l4).

endpoints.name: Generate a company list
endpoints.summary: Build a targeted company list from filters or a natural-language query.

query.description: Natural-language description of target companies. Use either query or filters, not both.
query.example: SaaS companies in the US with Series A funding

filters.description: Structured filters keyed by field path such as firmographic.company_type or location.hq.country (ISO alpha-3 codes); combined with AND. Ranges take {gte, lte}.

sections.description: Extra data sections to enrich each company with.

notes: A read over POST: it only queries. Pay-as-you-go plans are capped at 20 companies per request and cannot enrich.
Credits: a base cost plus an extra for natural-language query, a per-company cost and optional per-section costs.

endpoints.name: Search company and industry news
endpoints.summary: News with AI summaries, event types, sentiment and company mentions.

company.description: Website or company UUID. Not combined with primary_company.

primary_company.description: Only articles where this company is the primary company.

query.description: Open-ended topic. Not combined with title.

title.description: Search by article title. Not combined with query.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; non-enterprise plans look back at most 6 months.

unique_article.description: True groups similar articles from the same event.

notes: Credits: 0.1 per call plus 0.01 per article.
